reviews.title: Long-lasting Lightweight Champion
reviews.body: Loving this laptop so far.  With a powerful built in iGPU, beautiful 3K OLED screen, great battery life, and very good portability I want for nothing more in a laptop. reviews.title: Great Laptop in the Rampocalypse Era
reviews.body: Long time Lenovo user and thought I should give HP a try for this CPU generation. Very happy with this laptop overall. It has a premium feel and look, and it handles both my work and a heavy gaming load without breaking a sweat. I genuinely couldn’t be happier with the performance and build quality
